title: Sheaf refinement transport preserves the monic inclusion into direct image
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, X,Y schemes, f:X→Y a morphism, c,d compactifications of f [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and r:c→d a refinement whose square over X is cartesian. Write O_c=(c.i)!, P_c=(c.g)* on sheaves of A-modules on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Let β:O_c≅O_d⋙(r.hom)^* be inverse-image open base change and η the unit of (r.hom)^*⊣(r.hom)_*. Define t_r:O_d⋙P_d→O_c⋙P_c by the unit at O_d, then direct image of β inverse, then the canonical composition of direct images. For the compactification inclusions ι_c,ι_d [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison], t_r followed by ι_c equals ι_d. Every component of ι_c is a monomorphism. No invertibility of t_r is asserted.

proof.text: Transpose the open comparison through inverse image/direct image. The mate identity for open base change, together with the two open-adjunction triangle identities, gives that the adjunct of inverse open base change followed by the finer open inclusion and direct-image composition equals the coarser open inclusion. All maps are the existing open base-change and adjunction constructions.
Whisker the preceding equality by the coarser proper direct image. Naturality and associativity of the ordinary direct-image compositor identify the result with t_r;ι_c=ι_d.

The open inclusion is invertible on the open and has zero source on its closed complement. Exactness and joint conservativity of these restrictions imply its kernel vanishes. Apply the left-exact proper direct image and then the invertible compositor to obtain monicity of ι_c. This is the open/closed monomorphism argument already used in UnboundedEtaleCompactSupportComparisons.
